_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Operating, Support, Health, and Safety (OSH&S) Hazard Analysis Report
summary: Specifies the format and content for the Operating, Support, Health, and Safety (OSH&S) Hazard Analysis Report, used to identify and evaluate health hazards and propose measures to eliminate or control them.
use_relationship:
The Operating, Support, Health, and Safety Hazard Analysis Report (OSH&S) Report are used to systematically identify and evaluate health hazards, evaluate proposed hazardous materials, and propose measures to eliminate or control these hazards through engineering design changes or protective measures to reduce the risk to an acceptable level.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The OSH&S report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain a title page specifying the following:

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following sections:

children.title: System description
children.content: The system description shall contain a summary description of the physical and functional characteristics of the system and its components.

children.title: System capabilities, limitations, and interdependence of these components
children.content: shall contain relevance to system safety. Reword.

children.title: The system and components (software included)
children.content: shall be addressed in relation to its mission and its operational environment. System block diagrams and functional flow shall be included when applicable to clarify system descriptions.

children.title: References
children.content: This section shall identify all source documents i.e., reports, standards, criteria, technical manuals and specifications including industry specifications and standards used.

children.title: Identified health, operating and support, and safety hazards
children.content: and shall include the following information:

children.title: Identify the system/subsystem/unit that the analysis was performed for
Components/subsystem failure mode(s)
children.content: All failures modes which can result in a hazard. Failure modes generally answer the question of "how" it fails.

children.title: System event(s) phase
children.content: The configuration or phase of the mission the system is in when the hazard is encountered; for example, during maintenance, during pre-mobilization, installation, full-power applied, etc.

children.title: System operation description
children.content: A description of what is normally expected to occur as the result of operating the component/subsystem or performing the operating/maintenance action.

children.title: Hazard description
children.content: A complete description of hazard or hazardous materials. Also description of potential/actual hazard inherent in the item being analyzed or resulting from normal actions or equipment failure, or handling of hazardous materials.

children.title: Hazard identification/indication
children.content: A description of operator/crew indications which include all means of identifying the hazard to operational/maintenance personnel.

children.title: Effect of hazard
children.content: The detrimental effects which could be inflicted on the system, subsystem, equipment, facilities or personnel; resulting from this hazard. Possible upstream and downstream effects shall also be described.

children.title: Risk assessment
children.content: A risk assessment for each hazard (classification of severity and probability of occurrence). This is the assessment of the risk prior to taking any action to eliminate or control the hazard.

children.title: Recommendation action/mitigation
children.content: The recommended action/mitigation required to eliminate or control the hazard. Sufficient technical detail is required in order to permit the design engineers and the customer to adequately develop and assess design criteria resulting from the analysis. Include alternative designs and life cycle cost impacts where appropriate. Also include the effect of action/mitigation.

children.title: Remarks
children.content: Any information relating to the hazard not covered in other blocks; for example, previous failure data on similar systems or administrative directions.

children.title: A list of all hazardous materials
